text:
dana: Noticing a spike of auth failures + wrong role assignments for tenant 'acme-beta' after yesterday's SAML mapping change. Users end up with org-defaults instead of tenant-scoped roles. :warning:
kevin: repro steps? I can pull logs. Which assertion fields changed? :eyes:
dan a: Quick summary — we started allowing both `roles` and `tenant_id` claims in the assertion. The new mapper is supposed to namespace role names by tenant, but looks like when multiple assertions arrive for same `sub` we merge incorrectly and later assertions overwrite tenant-scoped roles.
anita_sec: Any crash logs or mapper warnings?
dana: Logs show a repeated message from role-mapper: `WARN role-mapper duplicate-namespace overwrite tenant=acme-beta sub=U12345 role=owner -> replaced by default:org_admin`
kevin: can you paste the SAML attribute snippet (redacted)?
dana: Sure, sanitized snippet:
```
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="sub">U12345</Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="tenant_id">acme-beta</Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="roles">owner;billing_admin</Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="email">alice@acme.example</Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>
```
ross_platform: The mapper config we deployed yesterday is this YAML (excerpt):
```
role_mapping:
  - match: { attribute: tenant_id }
    namespace: "${tenant_id}"
    source_roles: roles
    fallback: default:org_admin
```
ross_platform: The bug is that when a user has an existing session from another tenant (same `sub`), the code uses `session.roles` as the base and then applies mapping with `namespace`, but it never clears previous namespaced keys. So later default fallback overwrites the namespaced key in the flattened map.
anita_sec: That explains wrong final set. Is this JIT-specific or affects all SSO flows?
dana: Affects JIT provisioning path primarily (new user provisioning + existing sub merge). We see both newly provisioned users and returning users with cross-tenant access getting wrong roles.
infra-oncall: sso-bot reported several JIT failures earlier: `sso-bot: JIT provisioning failed: missing tenant_id claim for assertion from idp-okta (2023-11-09T14:02:18Z)` — those are separate but related.
kevin: Quick mitigation — can we change mapper to prefer namespaced keys and never write fallback into the global slot? I can whip up a hotfix to clear previous tenant keys before applying mapping.
ross_platform: Agreed. Also add a safety check: if `tenant_id` present then apply mapping into `namespaced_roles` structure and only flatten after dedupe and fallback resolution.
anita_sec: Add audit log entries for mapping decisions. Right now our audit only logs final role set, not mapping steps. We need `audit.role_mapping` with input attrs + decisions.
dana: For telemetry: affected tenant count ~ 6, impacted users ~ 42, timeframe ~ 13:30-14:05 UTC. I attached sample log lines: `INFO audit role-map sub=U12345 tenant=acme-beta in_roles=[owner,billing_admin] mapped=[acme-beta:owner,acme-beta:billing_admin] final=[org_admin]` — that final is wrong.
kevin: I'll branch `patch/fix-namespace-merge`, change RoleMapper.merge -> clearNamespacedKeys(sub) before apply, add unit + integration test for multiple-assertion sequence.
ross_platform: For immediate mitigation we can revert the mapping change to previous behavior (no tenant namespacing) until patch is validated. That will restore previous semantics (less secure but consistent). Ops, thoughts?
anita_sec: Revert OK for short window with approved rollback runbook. But require emergency audit forward: log all role changes and notify customers of possible transient permission changes.
infra-oncall: I'll prepare a rollback patch and schedule a deployment window in 20m if we decide. Also opening an incident ticket now.
sso-bot: AUTOMATION: Created incident INC-20231109-72: "SSO role overwrite affecting multi-tenant users" assigned to eng-security. Link: https://internal.incidents/INC-20231109-72
dana: Thanks. @kevin please take the code fix. @infra-oncall coordinate rollback if needed. @anita_sec confirm audit schema changes. I'll gather a list of affected accounts and reach out to customer success for notifications.
kevin: On it, will post PR link when ready. planning quick unit tests + integration run in staging.
anita_sec: I'll draft the audit schema now and add a temporary alert on spikes in `audit.role-mapping.fall_through` metric.
dana: Good. Keep updates in this thread and incident channel. :thumbsup:
